Name: The Forgotten Weaponsmith
Author: TimBukTw0
Description:
[b][size=4]Description:[/size][/b]
Deep within the mines, on floor 110, a gigantic metal door sits in the center. Seems it's been left untouched for ages. You enter a dwarven forge that resembles what you'd see in a volcano. Empty tables, a gated-off area, and a desk in the center. Behind this desk sits a strange sight — a mechanical being, currently powered down, who seems like he might be the owner. If only you could read Dwarf, 'cause there seems to be a message on his back.
However, if you do somehow turn on this being, you'll find out that it's an automated weaponsmith made before the War of Dwarves and Shadowfolk. Seems not only has his stock been ransacked, but his memory of weapon creation has rotted away with his dormancy. Seems he wants you to donate the weapons you collect on your journey so he can remember his roots. And seems he's willing to make you powerful replicas down the line.

[b][size=4]How to start:[/size][/b]
You need the dwarven translation guide, then click Werdon behind his desk (it tells you the next step).

[b][size=4]Main Features[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Donate any melee weapon to Werdon's Forge to bring it back to its former glory — compatible with modded weapons too![/*]
[*]A tiered donation system that progressively unlocks rewards the more you contribute.[/*]
[*]A weekly weapon shop that sells reproductions of your donated weapons, with stats and enchantments that scale as your tier rises.[/*]
[*]A chest slot/wishing system: guarantee a specific donated weapon appears in next week's shop. Has a 1.25/2x price boost depending on they way you asked for the item.[/*]
[*]A weapon display rack that shows off everything you've donated so far.[/*]
[*]A full donation tracker menu, split between vanilla and modded weapons, so you can always see what's left to find.[/*]
[*]Werdon himself: the robotic weaponsmith (custom made by me)[/*]
[*]Werdon's Forge: A custom made room to house Werdon[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Requirements:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Content Patcher[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Other things:[/size][/b] 
This mod was developed by a single player. I did however try to make multiplayer availability. Just don't open the menus at the same time and nothing should break. There is no code like the Daily Drop from Haunted Wardrobe, however I did place one chest behind a locked gate that contains a single unobtainable weapon. Unlike THW, donating weapons actually gives some big buffs, so weapon collection has been left a triumph for you to look up the wiki and just try and collect everything instead of me giving you a method to get them.

ALSO I did try to add a menu for donations in Androids. The android menu uses a shop menu and gives you 250g as its the only non item, item I could give you. You can force this menu If its not detecting android users (or you just want to use it) in the config. 

If any bugs occur tell me. I left a config bool called EnableDebugLogging which should tell you what is happening should you find one. Thanks for the future Bug reports.

[b][size=4]Shout Outs:[/size][/b]
Inspired by Stardew Aquarium and the many other "collect 'em all" style mods that make completing your collection actually feel rewarding. I used their donation menus to make my own, so I'm giving them the credit they deserve.
Mandarin (Simplified Chinese) translation by [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/194625283-cabbagebo/]CabbageBo[/url]
